basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Financial Advisor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is recruiting for 1 Financial Advisor post on a deputation basis, with an initial period of 3 years. Eligible candidates can apply offline by downloading the application form and submitting it through their employer to Shri Hawa Singh, Chief Administrative Officer, Room No. 210, II floor, Administrative Block, JIPMER, Dhanvantari Nagar on or before 16 November 2026. Applicants must be a Graduate in Commerce or Economics with SAS examination, or a Chartered Accountant, with required service experience. The notified pay

qualification.details: Service Eligibility: Officers of the Central / State / Union Territory Governments / Universities / Central Statutory / Autonomous Bodies / Public Sector Undertakings / Research and Development Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis, OR with 5 years regular service in the post in PB-3 with Grade Pay of Rs. 6,600. Educational & Professional Qualifications: Graduate in Commerce or Graduate in Economics (with Accounts and Audit as major subjects) and should have passed the SAS examination; OR should be a Chartered Accountant. Upper Age Limit: Not exceeding 56 years as on closing date.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Financial Advisor at a Glance

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER)
Graduate in Commerce/Economics with SAS or Chartered Accountant

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible officers fulfilling the qualifications and eligibility criteria must submit their applications through their proper channel (employer) to the following postal address: Shri Hawa Singh, Chief Administrative Officer, Room No. 210, II floor, Administrative Block, JIPMER, Dhanvantari Nagar, Puducherry – 605 006 The envelope containing the application must be super-scribed as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF FINANCIAL ADVISOR ON DEPUTATION BASIS AT JIPMER, PUDUCHERRY”. If applicants feel that the application through proper channel may get delayed, they are advised to send an advance copy of the application within the prescribed time limit.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Service Eligibility: Officers of the Central / State / Union Territory Governments / Universities / Central Statutory / Autonomous Bodies / Public Sector Undertakings / Research and Development Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis, OR with 5 years regular service in the post in PB-3 with Grade Pay of Rs. 6,600. Educational & Professional Qualifications: Graduate in Commerce or Graduate in Economics (with Accounts and Audit as major subjects) and should have passed the SAS examination; OR should be a Chartered Accountant. Upper Age Limit: Not exceeding 56 years as on closing date.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The following documents must invariably be sent along with the application: A certificate to the effect that the current employer has “No Objection” to the appointment of the applicant to the post applied for. Photocopies of APARs for the past five (5) years duly attested on each page by an Officer not below the level of Under Secretary or equivalent. A certificate of integrity of the applicant. Vigilance clearance certificate in respect of applicant duly signed by an officer of the appropriate status. Certificate indicating that no major/minor penalty has been imposed on the officer during the last 10 years/service period, whichever is less.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Financial Advisor post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Financial Advisor post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application is 16.11.2026 (Monday) till 4:30 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay scale for the Financial Advisor post?
faq.answer: The post is in Level-12 with a pay range of Rs. 78,800 – Rs. 2,09,200.

faq.question: Q5. What qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in Commerce or Economics with Accounts and Audit as major subjects and have passed the SAS examination, OR they must be a Chartered Accountant, along with the specified deputation service experience.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline through the proper channel (employer) to Shri Hawa Singh, Chief Administrative Officer, JIPMER, Puducherry – 605 006.

faq.question: Q7. Are persons working in private organizations eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, the post advertised does not apply to persons working in private organizations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the initial period of deputation?
faq.answer: The initial period of deputation shall ordinarily be 3 years from the date of appointment and is further extendable as per DoPT orders.
